description: This file defines a serializer class 'GuidCodec' for serializing and deserializing Guid values within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for writing and reading raw GUID bytes, handling different platform endianness, and integrating with the Orleans wire protocol.

classes.name: GuidCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec<Guid> for serializing and deserializing Guid values in Orleans serialization.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Guid value into the writer with a specified field ID delta.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a Guid value from the reader, ensuring the wire type and length are correct.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Writes the raw bytes of a Guid to the writer, handling platform endianness.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Reads raw Guid bytes from the reader, handling platform endianness.
